name: Fundraising Bar – A Sticky Customizable Donation Bar for WordPress
author: Dmitry

sections.description:
Fundraising Bar provides a simple way to add a PayPal donation bar to your WordPress site. Supporters can choose from preset amounts or enter a custom amount, optionally cover processing fees, and even make their donation recurring. An in-admin live preview lets you tweak colors and text on the fly, while sandbox mode helps ensure everything works perfectly before going live.

Fundraising Bar Free Version Features

  • Donation Bar Display: Show a customizable donation bar to accept contributions.
  • PayPal Integration: Accept one-time donations securely via PayPal.
  • Customizable Appearance: Adjust colors and text to fit your website’s branding.
  • Mobile-Friendly Design: Fully responsive for a seamless experience across devices.
  • Custom Donation Amounts: Allow donors to enter their own contribution amounts.
  • Recovery Fee Option: Enable donors to cover payment processing fees.
  • Basic Configuration: Set your fundraising goal and display settings with ease.

Fundraising Bar Pro Version Features

In addition to all the features in the free version, Fundraising Bar Pro includes:
– Recurring Donations: Accept monthly contributions via PayPal and Stripe.
– Stripe Integration: Securely process one-time and recurring payments with Stripe.
– Custom Logos: Add your own logo to personalize the donation bar.
– Live Preview: See real-time updates as you customize the bar’s appearance.
– Advanced Customization: Adjust text sizes, font styles, and other design elements.
– Fee Recovery Option: Expanded controls for managing fee recovery.
– Donor List Management: View and manage a list of donors directly within the plugin.
– Progress Bar and Fundraising Goal: Easily show donors how much has been raised so far (with a customizable “Raised So Far” field) versus your total goal.
– Conditional Display (Sitewide or Selected Pages/Posts): Choose whether to show the donation bar on every page/post or only on specific pages/posts.
– Custom Checkout Page: Create a tailored checkout experience to match your brand.
– Priority Support: Get access to dedicated customer support.
– Regular Updates: Benefit from ongoing feature improvements and enhancements.

– Custom Amounts – Let donors pick from predefined levels or enter their own.
– Fee Coverage – Give supporters the option to cover payment processing fees.

sections.installation:
1. Install the Plugin
    • Upload via FTP: Extract fundraising-bar.zip and upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
    • Or in WordPress: Go to Plugins → Add New, search for Fundraising Bar, or upload the .zip.
  2. Activate
    • Activate Fundraising Bar in your Plugins page.
  3. Configure Settings
    • Go to Settings → Fundraising Bar in your WordPress admin. Set preferred amounts, enable/disable recurring, and configure styling.
  4. Display the Bar
    • Once saved, the bar will appear according to your display settings (or via the shortcode [fundraising-bar] if your plugin provides one).
sections.faq:
What is Fundraising Bar?

Fundraising Bar is a powerful and easy-to-use WordPress plugin designed to help individuals, nonprofits, and organizations raise funds online. It provides a visually engaging donation bar that dynamically updates to reflect the total amount raised. Donations are processed securely through PayPal, and the plugin includes customization options to match your website’s branding. The Pro version adds recurring donations, Stripe support, live previews, donor management, and enhanced customization.

How do I configure the plugin settings?

Go to Settings → Fundraising Bar in your WordPress admin. Set your fundraising goal, customize the appearance of the bar, and enable payment options such as PayPal. Save your changes, and the donation bar will automatically appear on your website.

What payment methods are supported?

The free version supports donations via PayPal. For Stripe and recurring donations, upgrade to Fundraising Bar Pro.

Can I customize the appearance of the donation bar?

Yes. You can adjust the bar’s colors, text, and layout from the settings page. Pro adds logos and advanced styling.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. Fundraising Bar is fully responsive and designed to look great on all devices.

Does Fundraising Bar support custom donation amounts?

Yes. Donors can choose from predefined donation amounts or enter their own custom amount.

How does the donation bar appear on my site?

Once configured, the donation bar displays automatically based on your settings.

Is PayPal Sandbox supported?

Yes. You can enable sandbox mode in the settings to test before going live.
